rules.description: Checks that the percentage of deleted points is within the threshold.
Verifies that active Monthly and Quarterly Electricity StatVars have observations within 1 year of the current year and active Annual StatVars are within 2 years.

params.query: SELECT StatVar, MaxDate FROM stats WHERE NOT regexp_matches(StatVar, '_OtherSector$|(LigniteCoal|SubbituminousCoal)_IndustrialNonCogen$|Geothermal_(ElectricUtilityCogen|Commercial(NonCogen)?)$|OtherGases_CommercialCogen$|(Monthly|Quarterly)_Generation_Electricity_(ConventionalHydroelectric|UtilityScaleSolar(Photovoltaic)?)_ElectricUtilityCogen$|^Quarterly_AshContent_Fuel_ForElectricityGeneration_PetroleumLiquids_ElectricUtility$|^Quarterly_(AshContent|Average_Cost|Receipt|SulfurContent)_Fuel_ForElectricityGeneration_((BituminousCoal|Coal|PetroleumCoke|PetroleumLiquids)_IndustrialNonCogen|LigniteCoal_Industrial(Cogen)?|NaturalGas_CommercialNonCogen|PetroleumCoke_(Commercial(Cogen)?|ElectricUtility(Cogen|NonCogen)|IndependentPowerProducers|Industrial(Cogen)?)|PetroleumLiquids_Commercial(Cogen|NonCogen)?|SubbituminousCoal_(Commercial(Cogen)?|ElectricUtilityCogen))$')
params.condition: CAST(SUBSTR(MaxDate, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) >= EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - CASE WHEN regexp_matches(StatVar, '^(Monthly|Quarterly)_') THEN 1 ELSE 2 END

rules.description: Verifies the generated output CSV data matches established critical golden records
